_schema: GENGHIS fleet registry — see coordinator-notes.md for field definitions. THIS IS AN EXAMPLE. The real fleet.json is generated for YOUR machines by `genghis init` and is git-ignored (never committed). Every value here is a placeholder — replace with your own, or just run init.

coordinator.notes: control plane + model repository + telemetry ledger — the always-on node (a Pi, NAS, or mini-PC is ideal)

donors.notes: The orchestrator's own accelerator (local anchor — no RPC hop). `genghis init` fills this in from THIS machine.
An example remote donor running ggml-rpc-server on :50052. Add yours with `genghis init` (mDNS auto-discovery) or by hand.

_pending_donors.planned: A node you intend to add later — informational only, ignored by the planner.

_eye_nodes.notes: D20 task-fabric sensor node (camera trigger -> pooled VLM). Not a compute donor; excluded from the RPC pool by design.
